title: Multi-CLI workspace initialized
content: Initialized a Ghost In Shell v5 workspace with all four CLI adapters: Claude, Gemini, Codex, and Copilot.

title: Chose shared memory store pattern
content: All four CLIs share the same memory/episodic.jsonl file. Session boundaries are differentiated by the --runtime flag in gish log.

title: Session hooks verified for all four adapters
content: Claude uses the settings.json Stop hook. Gemini and Codex use wrapper scripts. Copilot uses a shell alias. All log to the same workspace via gish log --from-session.
